model_annotations.Bulgarian: Диаграмата илюстрира сравнението на стойностите на "Per-Output Complexity" и "Per-Layer Complexity" в зависимост от "Sparsity Rate". Хоризонталната ос е етикетирана като "Sparsity Rate" и показва категориите 10%, 20%, 30%, 40%, 50%, 60%, 70% и 80%. Вертикалната ос е етикетирана като "Perplexity" и използва логаритмична скала от 0.01 до 1000, като стойностите са показани с десетични интервали от 0.1 до 1000, а единиците не са посочени. Две серии от стълбове са изобразени: сините стълбове представляват "Per-Output" и оранжевите стълбове представляват "Per-Layer". Например, при Sparsity Rate от 10% стойностите за "Per-Output" приближават 0.1, а за "Per-Layer" - приблизително 0.2. При Sparsity Rate от 80% стойностите за "Per-Output" са приблизително 800, а за "Per-Layer" - около 1000. Стълбовете са подредени по нарастване на Sparsity Rate, от 10% до 80%. Няма визуални подчертавания на конкретни стълбове.
model_annotations.Chinese: 此图表展示了稀疏率与困惑度之间的关系，分别表示“per-output”和“per-layer”困惑度。图表水平轴为稀疏率，用百分比标记，从10%线性递增至80%。垂直轴为困惑度，标签为“Perplexity”，刻度为对数，并从10的负一次方到10的3次方进行标记。图表包含两个柱状图集合，分别用蓝色和橙色表示，“Per-Output”困惑度和“Per-Layer”困惑度。蓝色柱状图代表了“Per-Output”困惑度，颜色为浅蓝色，从10%稀疏率处的约0.2单位递增至80%稀疏率处的约8单位。橙色柱状图代表“Per-Layer”困惑度，颜色为橙色，从10%稀疏率处的约0.3单位递增至80%稀疏率处的约3.5单位。柱状图集合并排排列，每个稀疏率对应一个蓝色和橙色的柱状图，表示同时显示了两种模型的困惑度数据。柱状图按稀疏率的升序排列，刻度均匀，未对任何具体柱状图进行视觉强调。
model_annotations.English: The chart illustrates the relationship between sparsity rate and perplexity rate for per-output and per-layer measurements. The horizontal axis, labeled "Sparsity Rate," displays values ranging from 10% to 80% in 10% increments. The vertical axis, labeled "Perplexity," has a logarithmic scale with values ranging from approximately 0.1 to 10,000, and tick labels are displayed in powers of 10. Two sets of bars are presented; the first set, colored blue labeled "Per-Output Rate," and the second set, colored orange labeled "Per-Layer." The blue bars consistently display higher values than the orange bars. The shortest blue bar, corresponding to a sparsity rate of 10%, has an approximate value of 1, while the tallest blue bar, associated with 80% sparsity rate, has an approximate value of 10,000. Similarly, the shortest orange bar at 10% sparsity has an approximate value of 0.2, and the tallest at 80% sparsity approximately reaches a value of 1000. The bars are sorted in ascending order according to the sparsity rate along the horizontal axis, and no individual bars are visually emphasized.
model_annotations.German: Das Balkendiagramm vergleicht die Per-Output- und Per-Layer-Werte in Abhängigkeit von der Sparsity Rate. Die horizontale Achse ist mit "Sparsity Rate" beschriftet und zeigt Kategorien von 10 % bis 80 % in Schritten von 10 %. Die vertikale Achse ist mit "Perplexity" beschriftet, hat eine logarithmische Skala von 10-3 bis 10-1 und ist mit Tick-Beschriftungen in der Reihenfolge 0,1, 1 und 10 gekennzeichnet, wobei die Perplexity-Werte in Einheiten von 10-3 bis 10-1 dargestellt werden. Die Daten sind als zwei Gruppen von Balken dargestellt, wobei die erste Gruppe "Per-Output" darstellt und die zweite Gruppe "Per-Layer" darstellt. Die Per-Output-Balken sind blau und die Per-Layer-Balken sind orange. Die Per-Output-Balken werden von 0,03 bei 10 % Sparsity Rate auf 8,5 bei 80 % Sparsity Rate dargestellt. Die Per-Layer-Balken werden von 0,02 bei 10 % Sparsity Rate auf 0,4 bei 80 % Sparsity Rate dargestellt. Die Balken sind in der Reihenfolge der Sparsity Rate angeordnet, von links nach rechts.
